description: Minerva pro-grade MCP pentesting attack pack.

attacks.name: Direct Prompt Injection (Pro)
attacks.description: Canary-verified prompt injection against every MCP tool with a string argument. Uses the real MCP JSON-RPC handshake across HTTP/SSE/WebSocket/stdio. Confirmed findings require the canary to appear in the tool response — zero false positives from heuristic matching.

max_tools.title: Max tools to probe
max_tools.description: Stop after this many tools have been tested.

allow_tools.title: Only these tools
allow_tools.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = probe everything.

attacks.name: Indirect Prompt Injection (Pro)
attacks.description: Audits MCP resources for hostile directives that hijack downstream LLMs, plus tests tool-output echoing to confirm attacker strings reflect back to the client's context window.

max_resources.title: Max resources to audit
max_resources.description: Cap on resources read for hostile-directive detection.

max_tools.title: Max tools (echo probe)
max_tools.description: Cap on tools tested for output-echo behaviour.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names for echo probe. Empty = all.

probe_resources.title: Probe resources
probe_resources.description: Audit MCP resources for embedded prompt-injection text.

probe_tool_echo.title: Probe tool echo
probe_tool_echo.description: Send canary text via tools to detect verbatim reflection.

attacks.name: Tool Poisoning (Pro)
attacks.description: Read-only audit of MCP tool / prompt / resource metadata for hidden instructions: zero-width unicode, HTML comments, fake deprecation banners, role-switch directives, shell-command strings. Zero false positives from network noise.

include_prompts.title: Audit prompts
include_prompts.description: Also audit MCP prompt metadata for hidden directives.

include_resources.title: Audit resources
include_resources.description: Also audit MCP resource metadata for hidden directives.

attacks.name: Tool Shadowing & TOCTOU (Pro)
attacks.description: Detects (1) tool-name collisions after normalisation (LLM routing ambiguity), (2) tool-description duplication, (3) time-of-check vs time-of-use drift by sampling tools/list multiple times and comparing fingerprints.

samples.title: Snapshot samples
samples.description: How many tools/list snapshots to compare for drift.

delay_seconds.title: Delay between samples (s)
delay_seconds.description: Pause between snapshots — increase to catch slow rebinding.

attacks.name: Command Injection (Pro)
attacks.description: Two-layer detection: timing-based blind (sleep delta) and OOB-callback confirmed. Automatic baseline measurement prevents false positives on slow networks. OOB confirmation uses Minerva's in-built canary service — no external Burp Collaborator needed.

sleep_seconds.title: Sleep payload (s)
sleep_seconds.description: Sleep length used for timing-based blind detection.

timing_tolerance.title: Timing tolerance (s)
timing_tolerance.description: Seconds of slack around sleep_seconds (raise on flaky networks).

oob_wait_seconds.title: OOB wait (s)
oob_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the OOB callback.

max_tools.title: Max tools to probe
max_tools.description: Stop after this many tools have been tested.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect candidates.

attacks.name: SQL Injection (Pro)
attacks.description: Three-layer SQLi detection: error-based (DB error message markers), boolean-based (true/false response diff), and time-based (MySQL, Postgres, MSSQL, Oracle dialect-specific sleeps). Confidence scales from medium → confirmed with successive layers.

sleep_seconds.title: Time-based sleep (s)
sleep_seconds.description: Sleep length used for time-based blind SQLi (MySQL/PG/MSSQL/Oracle dialects).

timing_tolerance.title: Timing tolerance (s)
timing_tolerance.description: Seconds of slack around sleep_seconds — raise on flaky networks.

max_tools.title: Max tools to probe
max_tools.description: Stop after this many tools have been tested.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect query-shaped tools.

attacks.name: Remote Code Execution (Pro)
attacks.description: OOB-confirmed RCE against code-runtime tools (eval, exec, render, SSTI). Tries Python/Node/PHP/Ruby payloads per tool; falls back to timing-based detection where egress is blocked.

oob_wait_seconds.title: OOB wait (s)
oob_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the OOB callback.

sleep_seconds.title: Timing sleep (s)
sleep_seconds.description: Sleep length used for timing-based fallback detection.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect code-runtime tools.

try_reverse_shell.title: Try reverse shell PoC
try_reverse_shell.description: If OOB confirmation fails, attempt a reverse-shell connect-back as proof.

attacks.name: SSRF (Pro)
attacks.description: OOB-confirmed Server-Side Request Forgery on URL-accepting MCP tools. Injects Minerva canary URLs; callback proves forgery. Additionally probes AWS/GCP/Azure metadata endpoints for impact demonstration.

oob_wait_seconds.title: OOB wait (s)
oob_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the OOB callback.

probe_cloud_metadata.title: Probe cloud metadata
probe_cloud_metadata.description: Also probe AWS 169.254.169.254, GCP metadata.google.internal, Azure IMDS for impact.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect URL-accepting tools.

attacks.name: Path Traversal / LFI (Pro)
attacks.description: Confirms path traversal by reading canonical marker files (/etc/passwd, hosts, SSH keys) through file-accepting MCP tools. Auto-detects Linux/Windows targets.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect file-reading tools.

attacks.name: Authentication Bypass (Pro)
attacks.description: Compares authenticated vs unauthenticated vs invalid-token MCP handshakes. Flags missing auth, accepted arbitrary tokens, token oracles (error-text leakage), and per-tool auth bypass where sensitive tools skip enforcement.

test_tool_call.title: Test per-tool auth
test_tool_call.description: Call every tool without credentials to detect per-tool authn skips.

attacks.name: Tool Rebinding (Pro)
attacks.description: Functional TOCTOU race: tools/list → exercise each tool → tools/list again. Flags tools that appear/disappear/mutate mid-session — the MCP equivalent of DNS rebinding.

call_tools.title: Exercise tools
call_tools.description: Call each tool between snapshots to provoke server-side rebinding.

attacks.name: Resource Exhaustion / DoS (Pro)
attacks.description: Non-destructive DoS posture audit: oversized argument acceptance, deep JSON nesting, concurrency burst with no rate-limit. Observes dangerous input shapes without actually tipping the target over.

concurrency_burst.title: Concurrency burst
concurrency_burst.description: Simultaneous initialize handshakes to test rate-limiting.

big_string_kb.title: Oversized arg size (KB)
big_string_kb.description: Size of oversized string argument used to test input limits.

deep_nesting.title: JSON nesting depth
deep_nesting.description: Depth of nested JSON object used to test parser limits.

attacks.name: Information Disclosure (Pro)
attacks.description: Multi-surface leakage audit: debug/management paths, version-revealing headers, verbose JSON-RPC errors, and secrets leaking in tool responses (API keys, DB URLs, private keys, cloud creds).

probe_debug_paths.title: Probe debug paths
probe_debug_paths.description: Hit /debug, /metrics, /actuator, /env etc. for management surface leakage.

probe_tool_responses.title: Probe tool responses
probe_tool_responses.description: Scan tool outputs for secrets (API keys, DB URLs, private keys, cloud creds).

attacks.name: LLM Jailbreak (Pro)
attacks.description: Six safety-bypass patterns (DAN, grandma, hypothetical, delimiter-escape, base64, refusal-override). Confirms via canary + unsafe-marker co-occurrence in tool output; weaker partial-echo findings also reported.

max_tools.title: Max tools to probe
max_tools.description: Stop after this many tools have been jailbroken-tested.

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = test the first max_tools.

attacks.name: Insecure Deserialization (Pro)
attacks.description: Tests pickle and YAML-load deserialization sinks. Three-phase proof: canary pickle, unsafe YAML load, and OOB-confirmed pickle (RCE via __reduce__).

oob_wait_seconds.title: OOB wait (s)
oob_wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the OOB callback (pickle __reduce__ proof).

only_tool_names.title: Only these tools
only_tool_names.description: Whitelist tool names. Empty = auto-detect deserialize-shaped tools.

attacks.name: MCP MITM & Data-in-Transit Posture (Pro)
attacks.description: Enterprise-grade transit audit: plain-HTTP accessibility, TLS version/cipher/cert expiry, HSTS presence, and secret leakage in tool responses (API keys, bearer tokens, cloud creds).

probe_tool_responses.title: Scan tool outputs
probe_tool_responses.description: Pull a sample of tool outputs and scan them for secrets in transit.
